feedback_clusters.source: App Store Reviews & Beta Labs Surveys
feedback_clusters.summary: Gamma strike labels and pin price annotation are difficult to read in bright outdoor lighting when using light theme.
representative_quotes: Love the zero-gamma flip level, but I can barely read the strike numbers in the sun.
Light mode contrast on the GEX chart needs darker font or higher contrast pills.
